draft_text: The observed scores suggest a trend toward higher exact-match accuracy for Mirevant than for RookReader, rather than establishing that Mirevant is superior.
revised_text: Mirevant achieved higher exact-match accuracy than RookReader on the Norlake-QA test (74.6% vs 73.7%), with a paired 95% confidence interval for the mean difference of [0.24, 1.56] percentage points that excludes zero; no p-value was reported.
rationale: T1 shows Mirevant 74.6% vs RookReader 73.7%. A paired 95% CI [0.24, 1.56] for the mean difference excludes zero, supporting a stronger claim than a mere "trend." The sentence understates the evidence.
